description: Focused capability verification of the six Negotiation-T fromData interfaces: generateNegotiationProposePromptFromData, generateNegotiationAcceptPromptFromData, generateNegotiationRejectPromptFromData and their validate-and-extract counterparts. Inputs are traditional structured data - every item is one key (the slot name from the private-line-complaint Task-T template) with a value per the message type: propose carries the field expectation as a meaning-plus-sample description (the propose template's own requirement: name + meaning/format/sample), accept carries REAL field values (a live port name, an actual category value, a real event id), reject carries the unprovidable field name with its reason plus an explicit "无法提供" statement (the accept-reject template's own requirement: name + reason of non-provision). No natural-language passages, no format-spec placeholders, no template-error scenarios. The case matrix is built from the Task-T field model (required: 任务对象/投诉分类/OSS侧事件流水号; optional: 问题发生时间/投诉详情): propose carries every required/optional slot combination with real values (all required, each single required, dual required, required+optional, optional-only, empty boundary), accept supplies the filled values for the same combinations, reject carries the unprovidable fields with reasons. Generation is deterministic rendering (no LLM call); the validate-and-extract step asserts the extracted parameters carry back exactly the input key-value pairs.
